next.reason: 1985 GR10: 'The END-WRITE phrase delimits the scope of the WRITE statement' (Scope of Statements, IV-40). 2023 keeps the optional END-WRITE in the WRITE formats (§2023:14.9.51.2), Table 12 names it WRITE's scope terminator, and §2023:14.5.3.2 states its effect: it terminates 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' (GR1) and 'any unterminated statements that appear between that statement-name and the explicit scope terminator' (GR2). Same (as 1985-GR-IX.4.9.4-10).
